protocol.target: mean_{k=1..h} log(adjclose[t+k]/adjclose[t+k-1])^2; original zeros retained; no fill or replacement
protocol.origin: asset-specific observed dates from 2024-01-01; row t fully available; no date union
protocol.refit: expanding every 22 asset origins, including origins excluded from scoring; each horizon same refit dates
protocol.train: finite common features; s+h <= refit_t; cross-calendar-year labels excluded from training as well as scoring
protocol.EWMA: lambda=.94/.97; recursive initial r[1]^2, update including r[t]^2; h-step IGARCH variance constant
protocol.GARCH: arch zero-mean GARCH(1,1) Student-t on return*100; parameters fixed between refits; recursive variance filter updated each day; analytical mean of h future variances; divided by 10000
protocol.epsilon: asset-specific pre2024 mean(r^2)*1e-4, frozen; applied only inside logarithms; targets unmodified
protocol.HAR: OLS log(y+eps), training-residual Duan smearing; exp(xb)*smear-eps; nonpositive forecasts machine-tiny floored with flag
protocol.QHAR: mean(log(f)+y/f) + 0.01/2 sum(standardized slope^2); log link; unpenalized intercept; training-only standardization
protocol.features_return: log(rolling mean r^2 + eps), windows 1,5,22, includes t
protocol.features_joint: return features + log(rolling mean Parkinson + eps), windows 1,5,22 + log(rolling5 adjusted overnight gap^2 + eps)
protocol.qlike: log(f)+y/f; y=0 is valid; no log(y)
protocol.common_sample: all 9 methods scored on identical asset/horizon/year origin sets; no model-specific deletion
protocol.NW: Bartlett HAC mean loss difference t statistic, lag max(5,h-1), no finite sample or multiple testing correction; negative favors named model
protocol.deltas: model minus MA22 / model minus QHAR_liquidity; negative better

limits: All 2024/2025/2026 stages have been viewed; no clean test, exploratory mechanism probe, no novelty claim
Adjusted-close revision history is unavailable; downloaded adjustment factors are not proven historical point-in-time
Daily squared returns are noisy variance proxies; no intraday realized variance
Flat means high==low, not a zero close-to-close return; gap and Parkinson features are logged
Ridge is averaged-loss convention, 0.01/2 times squared slopes; no hyperparameter search
Cross-year exclusion also applied to training by conservative explicit convention
NW t statistics are exploratory with overlapping labels and no multiplicity adjustment
